judgments.note: Appeal of the DRB's June 4, 2007 final approval of a 36-unit PRD with fifteen new residential buildings; both shared decisions decide this docket (doc 1 Questions I-III of 126-6-07; doc 2 final-approval merits).
Court repeatedly says the application is de novo before it; held a six-day evidentiary hearing with site visit and decided the application itself.

Filing date not stated; start bounded by the July 20, 2007 revised Statement of Questions (on_or_before). End is the October 15, 2008 final decision; no Supreme Court appeal is observed, but one could exist outside these documents.
Final merits decision denying approval with nothing pending in this docket shown; possible later appeal not observable here.
Court resolved the 36 vs 39 confusion: 33 units in 15 new buildings plus 3 in the renovated Grange building = 36. The 3 Grange units are a renovation creating housing, counted.
Court states the project is not proposed for subdivision; land stays with the Trust, so 0 new residential lots.

Five named appellants; neighbor status is explicit for Hirschbuhl and David Roy (rear lot lines), Richard Roy (residence water line), and the court refers to 'Appellants' properties' near Route 4. Minotti and Stanglin's properties are not individually described (a 'Menotti property' near the brook may be Minotti's).

The whole surviving appeal was Question I's merits challenge under §§ 313, 709, 710, whose standards (adequacy of drainage, harmony, compatibility, character of area) are evaluative; the denial rested on them.
DRB granted final approval with Conditions 1-5 (text taken from parties' memoranda).
